from runtime import WorldSpec, Scene, Condition as C, Effect as E, Rule
from runtime import observe, tell, transfer
import random


def build(seed: int) -> WorldSpec:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    entities = {
        "ada": {"name": "Ada", "kind": "child"},
        "ben": {"name": "Ben", "kind": "child"},
        "mica": {"name": "Mica", "kind": "moth"},
        "keeper": {"name": "Garden steward", "kind": "person"},
        "night_garden": {"name": "night garden", "kind": "place"},
        "stone_path": {"name": "stone path", "kind": "place"},
        "fern_corner": {"name": "fern corner", "kind": "place"},
        "flower_bed": {"name": "flower bed", "kind": "place"},
        "lamp": {"name": "lamp", "kind": "prop"},
        "lamp_hook": {"name": "lamp hook", "kind": "place"},
        "low_stone": {"name": "low stone", "kind": "place"},
        "pale_cloth": {"name": "pale cloth", "kind": "prop"},
        "flower_sign": {"name": "flower sign", "kind": "prop"},
        "seed_pouch": {"name": "seed pouch", "kind": "prop"},
        "welcome_circle": {"name": "welcome circle", "kind": "place"},
    }

    high = rng.choice((True, False))
    shade_ready = rng.choice((True, False))
    landing = rng.choice(("fern", "flowers"))
    moth_start = rng.choice(("bright", "dark"))
    wind = rng.choice((True, False))

    initial = {
        "ada.memes.Curiosity": rng.choice((1, 2)),
        "ada.memes.Care": 1,
        "ben.memes.Care": rng.choice((1, 2)),
        "ben.memes.Ambition": rng.choice((1, 2)),
        "keeper.memes.Care": 2,
        "ada.location": "night_garden",
        "ben.location": "night_garden",
        "mica.location": moth_start,
        "mica.settled": False,
        "mica.comfort": "unknown",
        "lamp.lit": False,
        "lamp.brightness": 0,
        "lamp.position": "hook" if high else "stone",
        "lamp.shadow": "long" if high else "short",
        "lamp.owner": "keeper",
        "pale_cloth.location": "under_cloth" if shade_ready else "folded",
        "pale_cloth.hung": False,
        "pale_cloth.owner": "keeper",
        "pale_cloth.flutters": wind,
        "flower_sign.location": "flower_bed",
        "flower_sign.owner": "keeper",
        "seed_pouch.owner": "keeper",
        "flower_bed.clear": landing != "flowers",
        "fern_corner.clear": landing != "fern",
        "welcome_circle.ready": False,
        "welcome_circle.landing": None,
        "welcome_circle.light_style": None,
        "welcome_circle.resting_place": None,
        "ada.knows.lamp.lit": None,
        "ada.knows.lamp.position": None,
        "ada.knows.lamp.shadow": None,
        "ada.knows.mica.location": None,
        "ada.knows.landing": None,
        "ben.knows.mica.location": None,
        "keeper.knows.need": None,
    }

    rules = (
        Rule(
            "lamp_position_is_valid",
            (C("lamp.position", "in", ("hook", "stone")),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "cloth_location_matches_hanging",
            (
                C("pale_cloth.hung", "eq", True),
                C("pale_cloth.location", "eq", "lamp"),
            ),
            when=(C("pale_cloth.hung", "eq", True),),
        ),
        Rule(
            "settling_requires_ready_circle",
            (C("welcome_circle.ready", "eq", True),),
            when=(C("mica.settled", "eq", True),),
        ),
    )

    scenes = [
        observe(
            "inspect_lamp", "ada", "lamp.lit",
            requires=(
                C("ada.location", "eq", "night_garden"),
                C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1),
            ),
            summary="Ada inspected the lamp",
        ),
        Scene(
            "light_lamp", "ambition", ("ben", "lamp"),
            (
                C("ben.location", "eq", "night_garden"),
                C("ben.memes.Ambition", "ge", 1),
                C("lamp.lit", "eq", False),
            ),
            (
                E("lamp.lit", True),
                E("lamp.brightness", 2),
                E("lamp.shadow", "long"),
            ),
            "Ben lit the garden lamp",
        ),
        Scene(
            "dim_lamp", "care", ("ben", "lamp"),
            (
                C("ben.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
                C("lamp.lit", "eq", True),
                C("lamp.brightness", "gt", 1),
            ),
            (
                E("lamp.brightness", 1),
                E("lamp.shadow", "soft"),
            ),
            "Ben dimmed the lamp for the moth",
        ),
        Scene(
            "mica_circles", "observation", ("mica", "night_garden"),
            (
                C("mica.settled", "eq", False),
                C("lamp.lit", "eq", True),
            ),
            (
                E("mica.location", moth_start),
            ),
            "Mica circled the garden and paused at an edge",
        ),
        observe(
            "inspect_mica", "ada", "mica.location",
            requires=(
                C("ada.location", "eq", "night_garden"),
                C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1),
                C("mica.settled", "eq", False),
            ),
            summary="Ada watched where Mica paused",
        ),
        observe(
            "inspect_shadow", "ada", "lamp.shadow",
            requires=(
                C("ada.location", "eq", "night_garden"),
                C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1),
                C("lamp.lit", "eq", True),
            ),
            summary="Ada inspected the lamp shadow",
        ),
        Scene(
            "find_landing", "observation", ("ada", "stone_path"),
            (
                C("ada.knows.lamp.shadow", "ne", None),
                C("ada.knows.mica.location", "ne", None),
                C("ada.knows.landing", "eq", None),
            ),
            (
                E("ada.knows.landing", landing),
            ),
            "Ada traced the shadow and chose a landing edge",
        ),
        tell(
            "explain_need", "ada", "keeper", "landing",
            requires=(C("ada.knows.landing", "ne", None),),
            summary="Ada explained the landing need to the steward",
        ),
        transfer(
            "lend_cloth", "keeper", "ada", "pale_cloth",
            requires=(
                C("keeper.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
                C("keeper.knows.need", "ne", None),
                C("pale_cloth.owner", "eq", "keeper"),
                C("pale_cloth.location", "in", ("folded", "under_cloth")),
            ),
            summary="The steward lent Ada the pale cloth",
        ),
        Scene(
            "hang_cloth", "cooperation", ("ada", "ben", "pale_cloth"),
            (
                C("pale_cloth.owner", "eq", "ada"),
                C("pale_cloth.hung", "eq", False),
                C("pale_cloth.flutters", "eq", False),
                C("lamp.lit", "eq", True),
            ),
            (
                E("pale_cloth.hung", True),
                E("pale_cloth.location", "lamp"),
                E("lamp.shadow", "soft"),
            ),
            "Ada and Ben hung the still cloth as a soft screen",
        ),
        Scene(
            "move_lamp_low", "cooperation", ("ada", "ben", "lamp"),
            (
                C("lamp.lit", "eq", True),
                C("lamp.position", "eq", "hook"),
                C("ada.knows.lamp.position", "ne", None),
                C("ben.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
            ),
            (
                E("lamp.position", "stone"),
                E("lamp.shadow", "short"),
            ),
            "The children moved the lamp to the low stone",
        ),
        Scene(
            "clear_landing", "care", ("ada", "ben", "flower_sign"),
            (
                C("ada.knows.landing", "ne", None),
                C("ben.memes.Care", "ge", 1),
                C("flower_sign.location", "eq", "flower_bed"),
            ),
            (
                E("flower_bed.clear", True),
                E("fern_corner.clear", True),
            ),
            "The children cleared a broad landing space",
        ),
        tell(
            "share_moth", "ada", "ben", "mica.location",
            requires=(C("ada.knows.mica.location", "ne", None),),
            summary="Ada told Ben where Mica paused",
        ),
        Scene(
            "test_arrangement", "observation", ("ada", "ben", "mica"),
            (
                C("mica.settled", "eq", False),
                C("ben.knows.mica.location", "ne", None),
                C("welcome_circle.ready", "eq", False),
                C("lamp.lit", "eq", True),
            ),
            (
                E("mica.comfort", "edge"),
            ),
            "The children tested the quieter edge",
        ),
        Scene(
            "mark_circle", "cooperation", ("ada", "ben", "welcome_circle", "flower_sign"),
            (
                C("ada.knows.landing", "ne", None),
                C("flower_bed.clear", "eq", True),
                C("fern_corner.clear", "eq", True),
                C("lamp.lit", "eq", True),
            ),
            (
                E("welcome_circle.ready", True),
                E("welcome_circle.landing", "copy", "ada.knows.landing"),
                E("welcome_circle.light_style", "copy", "lamp.shadow"),
                E("welcome_circle.resting_place", "flower_sign"),
                E("flower_sign.location", "welcome_circle"),
            ),
            "The children marked the ready welcome circle",
        ),
        Scene(
            "mica_settles", "care", ("mica", "welcome_circle"),
            (
                C("welcome_circle.ready", "eq", True),
                C("mica.settled", "eq", False),
                C("welcome_circle.landing", "in", ("fern", "flowers")),
                C("welcome_circle.light_style", "in", ("soft", "short")),
            ),
            (
                E("mica.settled", True),
                E("mica.location", "welcome_circle"),
                E("mica.comfort", "safe"),
            ),
            "Mica settled safely in the prepared welcome circle",
        ),
    ]

    goal = (
        C("mica.settled", "eq", True),
        C("welcome_circle.ready", "eq", True),
        C("mica.comfort", "eq", "safe"),
    )

    labels = {
        "lamp.position": "lamp position",
        "lamp.brightness": "lamp brightness",
        "lamp.shadow": "shadow quality",
        "mica.location": "Mica's location",
        "mica.settled": "Mica settled",
        "welcome_circle.ready": "welcome circle ready",
        "welcome_circle.landing": "chosen landing area",
        "pale_cloth.hung": "cloth hung",
    }

    return WorldSpec(
        "The Moonlit Welcome",
        entities,
        initial,
        tuple(scenes),
        goal,
        rules=rules,
        labels=labels,
    )
